content: Obsidian views: registerView(type, leaf=>new View(leaf)) in onload; never keep view references; activateView = getLeavesOfType -> else getRightLeaf(false).setViewState({type,active:true}) -> await revealLeaf(leaf) (Promise since 1.7.2); ensureSideLeaf(type,'right',{active,reveal}) since 1.7.2; deferred leaves (isDeferred/loadIfDeferred) since 1.7.2; don't detach leaves in onunload so layout restores in place. TaskNotes PomodoroView: ItemView, vanilla createDiv DOM with cached element refs and in-place updates, awaits plugin.onReady() in onOpen with openGeneration guard, cleans listeners in onClose.
